author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಒತ್ತೆ ಇಡುವಳು ಜೀವ ನಿನಧರೆಗೆ ತರಲವಳು
ಸೆತ್ತೆ ನಿನ ಜೊತೆಯಲ್ಲೆ ಹೊತ್ತು ಸಹಿಸುವಳು
ಬತ್ತುತಿರೆ ನಿನಭಕ್ತಿ ಹೆತ್ತವಳ ಗಮನಿಸಲು
ಸತ್ತುಹೊಗುವೆಯೊ ನರಕ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: She pawns her own life to bring you to this earth;
wearied, she carries and bears you at her side;
if your devotion dries up when it comes to caring for your mother,
you will die and go to hell, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A mother risks her life to give us ours and carries us through everything. Neglecting her in turn is among the gravest failings.
